cand.title: Opened a new Tlajomulco distribution center and announced MXN 3.75 billion of Jalisco investment from 2026-2031, with additional distribution centers contemplated toward 2028.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No lodging contract buyer was verified. Two relevant referral candidates are Jorge Ramírez Sedano, Head of Expansion at Tiendas Bara | FEMSA, whose profile describes Jalisco expansion, construction and cross-functional coordination; and Edgar Zorro, Gerente Sr Regional de Operaciones at Tiendas Bara | FEMSA in Guadalajara. Their functions make them plausible sponsors/referrers for project-travel and training discovery, an inference rather than demonstrated hotel-contract authority.
findings.futureEdition: No future event edition or dated meeting was verified within November 2026–May 2028. FEMSA announced MXN 3.75 billion of Jalisco investment during 2026–2031 and contemplated additional distribution centres toward 2028. These are programme horizons, not event dates or proof of delivery by May 2028. The existing centre began operations on 17 August 2026 and was inaugurated on 8 September 2026; both activities precede the requested horizon.
findings.hotelProductFit: Conditional thesis, not verified demand: approach for visiting expansion/construction specialists, regional management visits and off-site training or supplier meetings. Sheraton Guadalajara Expo is a city-business meeting fit rather than a resort proposition: Marriott markets corporate meeting space near Expo Guadalajara, including Cuarzo with 160 schoolroom capacity. However, the CEDIS serves the south/east metropolitan area on carretera Guadalajara–El Salto, not the Expo corridor. Expo proximity alone is not a demand linkage. Confirm where visitors actually work and acceptable transport arrangements before proposing the hotel; no travel-time or transport-cost assumption is supported.
findings.venueCommitments: Historical physical site: Centro de Distribución Jalisco / CEDIS Tlajomulco, on carretera Guadalajara–El Salto, Tlajomulco de Zúñiga. The reported inauguration concerned this operating logistics facility, not a hotel booking. No future meeting venue, host hotel, accommodation commitment or incumbent hotel was identified in the reviewed sources.
findings.historicalRotation: No edition timeline or destination rotation is established. The verified milestone is a one-time distribution-centre opening, not an annually rotating event. Additional facilities contemplated toward 2028 do not establish event recurrence.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: UNKNOWN, not confirmed open or closed. No hotel RFP, room block, travel-management company, PCO, DMC, preferred hotel or meeting-accommodation purchasing mandate was verified. FEMSA publishes abastecimientosfemsa@femsa.com.mx for offering products/services to its procurement area. This is a general supplier-routing channel, not a Bara hotel tender or proof that parent-company procurement buys Bara lodging.
findings.organizationStructure: Tiendas Bara is a FEMSA retail subsidiary and the operating company behind the distribution-centre and store expansion. This is a corporate infrastructure/retail programme, not an association or verified conference organizer. Government officials attended the inauguration; attendance does not establish accommodation buying authority. No external event agency, PCO or DMC was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No incumbent hotel, negotiated rate, exclusive accommodation arrangement, capacity shortfall or overflow requirement was verified. Inference: the Expo-area location may be less compelling for site-intensive CEDIS visits than for city-based executive meetings; route suitability, budget and any existing corporate hotel programme must be tested. Local headcount, investment and store capacity cannot be converted into room demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Remove the past inauguration from the active events pipeline; retain a corporate-project relationship lead. Ask Jorge Ramírez Sedano for the November 2026–May 2028 Jalisco project/visitor calendar and a referral to travel/procurement; ask Edgar Zorro whether regional visits or training generate nonlocal overnight stays or off-site meetings. Use FEMSA’s published supplier channel to confirm the correct Bara procurement entity and vendor-onboarding route. Request incumbent agreements, renewal dates, actual room nights, traveller origins, budgets, working locations and transport requirements. Offer a site visit and tailored corporate/meeting proposal only after demand and accessibility are confirmed; do not create an RFP or room block.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 8 September 2026 inauguration is expired and must not be marketed as an upcoming opportunity as of 14 November 2026. Operations began even earlier, on 17 August 2026. There is no verified current event to bid for and no evidence establishing either open or closed hotel sourcing.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Unqualified corporate-account potential only. The 2026–2031 programme overlaps the target horizon, but no visit calendar, dated 2027/2028 opening, event recurrence, hotel demand or competitive procurement window was verified. A possible project-travel/training relationship is an explicit inference; it is not a confirmed future edition or recurring competitive-capture opportunity.
